epic.title: Dev Dashboard: Internal API Entity Operations
epic.note: Single slice — #299 (referral CRUD) is one PR on main, a rebase of the reviewed #219; the practice-CRUD groundwork it mirrors (#293) is already merged. Not a multi-PR stack.
epic.goal: Operators need to inspect and correct individual referral records without DynamoDB console access. This slice adds typed create / read / update / delete over the PHI-carrying Referral entity, declared in the internal OpenAPI spec and implemented against the merged repository — the referral counterpart to the practice CRUD.

layers.summary: Five internal PCP referral CRUD endpoints for the PHI-carrying entity, declared in the internal OpenAPI spec and implemented against the merged repository. Headline finding: AJV silently refuses null on type+enum+nullable:true enum fields, so the two nullable stage fields use anyOf instead.
